name: deck-validator
body: Deck validator: walks deck → slides → sections/fields recursively applying schema rules; fail-fast — stops at the first error and returns it path-qualified with hint and closest-match suggestion; formats it for terminal and browser. Walk order is fixed and deterministic: (1) kalide.yaml, (2) slide filenames (numbering, letters, label uniqueness), (3) slides in number/letter order, each top-to-bottom by line (frontmatter, body, sections, fields), (4) a final pass resolving inter-slide #label links against the full label set.
